h: פָּרָשַׁת כִּי תָבוֹא, א׳ Ki Savo, 1
Bikkurim Refine Israel Through the Holiness of the Kohen

p: "And it shall be, when you come into the land
that Hashem your God gives you" (Devarim 26:1).
just as the Ten Commandments open
and it is not written as a command
that they believe that "I am Hashem your God,"
even though it is a mitzvah;
as the Rishonim, of blessed memory, said,
that a command is not applicable to faith;
And the Name Havayah, blessed is He,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג רנח, א)
that the letters Yud-Hei of the Name
up to the attribute of Yesod;
alludes to the attribute of Malchus;
and the crown of the Yud
is the One who guides you.
And it is written in this passage
the words of the Torah to Yisrael,
"I declare today to Hashem your God,"
what the one bringing Bikkurim says
At first glance, why the expression
and he does not say "to Hashem our God"?
And so the holy Zohar asks
But the matter of the nine times
which is the attribute of Malchus
is not every one of Yisrael
And for this it is written
for the one who brings Bikkurim
which is the attribute of Tzaddik,
in this only in the future
will all of Yisrael be refined,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב כג, א)
and then death will be swallowed up forever,
all the blemish and corruption of the serpent.
And Eliyahu, the angel of the covenant,
who is present at every bris milah
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק א צג, א)
and of whom it is written (Bamidbar 25:12):
to be living and enduring forever.
And in the Midrash (Rabbah and Tanchuma on Emor; Vayikra Rabbah 27:4):
that had Adam HaRishon not sinned
he would have lived and endured forever,
and he lives and endures forever," etc.;
merited to be refined in this
And corresponding to this is the pasuk
"I declare today to Hashem your God":
as it is written of every Kohen (Malachi 2:5):
and I gave them to him for fear, and he feared Me";
which is the attribute of Yosef HaTzaddik,
who was refined in this attribute,
as it is written of him (Bereishis 42:18):
And with this it is well
that he says "to Hashem your God,"
which corresponds to the ninth attribute;
for he says this only to the Kohen,
"And you shall come to the Kohen
who will be in those days,"
on which the Ramban, of blessed memory, asked:
regarding one who brings Bikkurim to a Kohen,
of writing "who will be in those days"?
To whom would he bring them
who will be in those days?
But according to what has been said it is understood:
since he says to the Kohen
in the attribute of Tzaddik, foundation of the world
but there may be a Kohen
who is not yet so refined
"And you shall come to the Kohen
who will be in those days."
And it is like what they said (Rosh Hashanah 25b):
is like Shmuel in his generation";
since he is of the seed of Aharon HaKohen,
"and I gave them to him for fear, and he feared Me";
and he is refined in the attribute of Tzaddik,
are called "those who fear My Name" (Taanis 8b),
and "the awe of Shabbos is upon the unlearned"
and Shabbos is in the secret of the covenant,
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק א נו, א וְחֵלֶק ב צב, א)
that on Shabbos every one of Yisrael
and they merit to be refined
And Shabbos corresponds to the attribute of Malchus,
and one who keeps Shabbos according to its halachah
And although not everything is yet rectified,
for the world is judged by its majority,
kept Shabbos according to its halachah
and death is only like sleep and waking,
"and when you awake, it shall talk with you."
